message.content: {"visual_impact":{"choice":"non_material","rationale":"The target presents a coherent, usable MTS telecom homepage: its 5G promotion and call to action are legible, navigation and service categories are identifiable, and support, news, useful materials, and footer information remain readable in the supplied lower views. The broken hero image is a visible defect, but the accompanying headline, description, and button communicate the promotion; it does not make essential information or controls unusable. Other layout and content differences do not materially impair the interface."}}
